title: fix: stop transient profile-load errors from showing "cannot access Ivra"
body:
## Summary

Fixes the "Ce compte connecté ne peut pas accéder à Ivra" screen that locked a valid account out of the app **even online**, requiring a full app restart.

Root cause: the router parks the user on login whenever `currentUserProvider` (the profile read) errors, and the login screen always labeled *any* such error as "this account cannot access Ivra" with only a sign-out button. On a cold start the saved access token can be momentarily expired, so the very first `profiles` request fails with a JWT/network error before Supabase auto-refreshes the session — a transient failure that was being treated as a permanent authorization denial. (Verified the DB is healthy: both accounts have active profile rows that read correctly under RLS, so the failure is transient, not authorization.)

Changes:
- `SupabaseIvraRepository.currentUser()` now retries the profile fetch once (after a short delay) on a transient JWT/network error, so the cold-start token-refresh race usually self-heals and the user never sees an error.
- New `isTransientProfileError()` classifier distinguishes transient errors (network, timeout, expired JWT) from genuine ones (deactivated account, no profile row).
- Login screen: for a transient profile error it now shows a neutral "We couldn't load your profile" message **with a Retry button** (re-runs the profile load in place — no forced sign-out / restart). Genuine authorization failures keep the original "cannot access" message + sign-out.
- Localized the new strings (title/body, reusing existing `btnRetry`) in EN/FR/AR/IT.

```
currentUser(): fetch profile
  └─ transient (JWT/network)? → wait 700ms → retry once
        └─ still failing → UI shows "couldn't load profile" + [Retry] (+ Sign out)
  └─ genuine (deactivated / no row) → "cannot access Ivra" + Sign out
```

## Verification

- [x] `flutter analyze` (changed files) — No issues found
- [x] `flutter test test/auth_profile_error_test.dart test/biometric_auth_test.dart` — 11/11 passed
- [ ] `flutter build web`
- [ ] `flutter build apk --debug` when Android/resources/build config changed

Note: biometric/profile flow can only be fully exercised on a real Android device.

## Supabase

- [x] No Supabase changes

- [ ] Docs updated when setup, deployment, or operations changed
